source.title: DisenchantValue v1.2.0 Midnight expansion support changelog
source.author: GildedFool

notes: NEW independent March 2 Retail addon-release source verifies that tooltip valuation heuristics group input quality 2 with Eversinging Dust 243599/243600, input quality 3 with Radiant Shard 243602/243603, and input quality 4 with Dawn Crystal 243605/243606. This is NOT a player material outcome study: no original casts, bonus-linked source itemIDs, output quantities/hits, per-cast zeros, histograms, build-at-cast, profession context, or rank-specific probabilities. The one-primary-family-per-quality shorthand does NOT prove exclusivity (prior item-specific Looter source data includes mixed outcomes); do not import it as evidence probabilities, assign Dawn Crystal Q1/Q2 to same-name Wowhead Looter rows, or infer ilvl 305 DE eligibility for Miststalker's Wristbands 272246. Examined the independent code-backed Disenchanting Advisor and Shattersight trackers: their SavedVariables aggregate by quality/expansion/25-skill bucket and omit per-source itemLink/bonus and true-zero events; neither publishes a new raw study. Other priority by-name searches for Umbral Tin Ore 237362, Refulgent Copper Ore 237359, Brilliant Silver Ore 237365, Tranquility Bloom 236761 returned only prior indexed source families or guide/recipe statements. No new numerical baseline or measurement is claimed.
lookingFor: Fresh original Retail Midnight 2026 source-linked material-yield cohorts for Miststalker's Wristbands 272246, input gear qualities and actual item level, Umbral Tin Ore 237362, Refulgent Copper Ore 237359, Brilliant Silver Ore 237365 and Tranquility Bloom 236761; distinguish external valuation heuristics from original player outcomes
